description: This file defines the MicroblogObject class, which generates a structured representation of microblog posts with various attributes, inheriting from AbstractMISPObjectGenerator.

classes.name: MicroblogObject
classes.description: A class for creating microblog post objects with attributes such as post content, title, link, URL, archive, user info, language, type, state, hashtags, and IDs.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a MicroblogObject with parameters and calls generate_attributes to populate its attributes.

methods.name: generate_attributes
methods.description: Populates the object with attributes based on provided parameters, including post content, links, user info, language, type, state, hashtags, and IDs.
